heading: Our work goes beyond just 'opening a company'.
content: We design tailored structures (LLC in the U.S., holding companies, partnerships, trusts, and entities in different jurisdictions), connect them with the international financial and payment system (banks and fintechs), and handle accounting and tax compliance with authorities such as the IRS and other regulatory bodies. All with an integrated view of your personal, family, and business situation.

heading: We are characterized by a close, technical, and strategic approach.
content: We explain each step in clear language, propose only structures we understand and support, and prioritize long-term relationships based on trust, confidentiality, and results. Our goal is for you to feel accompanied throughout the process, with the peace of mind of having a team that understands both the legal and tax world and the practical reality of doing business from Latin America to the world.
